highlights:
South Korea and Czech Republic begin their FIFA World Cup 2026 Group A campaigns at Guadalajara Stadium with both teams carrying useful unbeaten runs into the tournament. The matchup looks balanced, with South Korea offering stronger defensive trends and the Czech Republic bringing enough attacking quality to keep the contest close.
[...]
South Korea meet Czech Republic in Group A of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Guadalajara Stadium, and the opening match should tell us plenty about how both sides intend to approach the section. South Korea arrive with a strong recent body of work under Myung-Bo Hong, while Czech Republic, coached by Miroslav Koubek, have also built a run of competitive resilience.

Their last 16 matches include 8 wins, with averages of 1.88 goals scored and 1.19 conceded, which points to a side capable of staying competitive even when matches become stretched.
[...]

The final outcome probability leans toward a draw at 35%, with fewer than 3 goals expected. Czechia bowed out in the group stage in 2006 in their only previous FIFA World Cup finals as an independent nation, and will be aiming to go further than that in 2026. Miroslav Koubek's side, led by captain Ladislav Krejčí﻿, face South Korea, South Africa and Mexico in Group A. Hired in December 2025, the 74-year-old Koubek steered Czechia through two play-off shoot-outs to reach their first World Cup finals since 2006. A goalkeeper who ended his playing career at Sparta Praha, Koubek’s long coaching career includes three spells at Viktoria Plzeň, during the second of which (in 2014/15) he led the club to the Czech title.

Not to be confused with the midfielder with the same name who played over 40 games for Czechia, the current team captain is a central defender who spent the 2025/26 season with Wolves in England. A two-time Czech champion with Sparta Praha, the 27-year-old was chosen as Czechia captain in March 2026.

Czechoslovakia were runners-up at the second and seventh World Cup finals, and famously won the UEFA European Championship in 1976, but the independent Czechia has had less impact in the World Cup. Prior to reaching the 2026 finals, they had only qualified for the 2006 World Cup, and failed to make it through the group stage.

highlights:
Paraguay returns to the FIFA World Cup after a 16-year absence, relying on a robust and experienced defence under manager Gustavo Alfaro. Their qualification was built on low-scoring, disciplined performances, making them tough opponents. While strong at the back and equipped with Premier League talent in Diego Gomez and exciting attackers like Julio Enciso, expectations of a lengthy run are low. Still, Paraguay could surprise in Group D against USA, Turkey, and Australia, with value in betting on low-scoring games rather than an outright win.
